versions.changelog: v1.1: json-diff round-trip replaces clean-export-as-default. inject.py snapshots true orig innerHTML and exports {orig,new} changes; new apply_edits.py backfills edits into source by content match (immune to position drift, refuses ambiguous matches). Hybrid DOM walk covers div-text and orphan text in flex/grid cards. Clean HTML export retained as fallback only.
v1.0.0 first publish: hybrid DOM walk text editor; covers div-wrapped & orphan text in flex/grid cards; click-to-edit, localStorage save, export clean HTML; bilingual EN/中.
